newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Bond reforms may lure Goldman to S.Africa - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bond reforms may lure Goldman to S.Africa - paper.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs is likely to open an office in South Africa in the next six months in a bid to cash in on upcoming bond market reforms, the Business Day newspaper said on Friday.
"We are seriously reassessing our activities in emerging markets and South Africa is obviously very important in that context," the paper quoted a bank spokesman saying from London.
Market talk is that Goldman Sachs is keen to become a market-maker in South African government bonds once reforms are put in place to open the function to private institutions.
U.S. investment bank J.P Morgan told Reuters last week that it, too, was interested in becoming a bond market-maker.
